description: Show an installed app only in a daily time window, by the phone's clock (see set_phone_time) or in the time zone you give, for example your Tasks app from 08:00 to 10:00 on weekdays. from and to are HH:MM (default 00:00 and 23:59); a window that crosses midnight belongs to the day it starts. Leave days out for every day. timezone is an optional IANA name such as Europe/Berlin or America/New_York: from, to and days are then read in that zone, whatever the phone clock is. Pin and hide still apply. Same schedule as arrange_apps. Fails with not_installed, bad_placement or bad_timezone.

timezone.description: IANA time zone name, for example Europe/Berlin

name: schedule_app
